credit : ZeLuckyMc

TITLE: More+ Animation Player Setup (Rotation Only)
DESC: A Molang-based setup designed to dynamically manipulate and control the rotation and position of specific bones within the player model.
TAG: complex,visual

H3: Command Block:

CMD:R:AA:U:100
playanimation @a animation.minecart.move.v1.0 xyz 0 "v.root.x=v.root.x??0;v.root.z=v.root.z??0;v.body.x=v.body.x??0;v.body.y=v.body.y??0;v.body.z=v.body.z??0;v.head.x=v.head.x??0;v.head.y=v.head.y??0;v.head.z=v.head.z??0;v.rightleg.x=v.rightleg.x??0;v.leftleg.x=v.leftleg.x??0;v.rightarm.x=v.rightarm.x??0;v.leftarm.x=v.leftarm.x??0;v.rightarm.y=v.rightarm.y??0;v.leftarm.y=v.leftarm.y??0;v.rightarm.z=v.rightarm.z??0;v.leftarm.z=v.leftarm.z??0;v.rightarm.ypos=v.rightarm.ypos??0;v.leftarm.ypos=v.leftarm.ypos??0;v.rail_offset.x=0.625;v.rail_offset.y=18.5/16-0.75*math.cos(v.body.x);v.rail_offset.z=1.2*v.is_first_person-1.875+0.75*math.sin(v.body.x);" pivot_offset.body_x?pos.root_xz
CMD:C:AA:U:0
playanimation @a animation.parrot.dance xy 0 "v.dance.x=11.25*math.sin(v.body.z)+this+9*v.is_first_person;v.dance.y=11.25*(math.cos(v.body.z)-1)+7*v.is_first_person;" pivot_offset.body_z
CMD:C:AA:U:0
playanimation @a animation.ender_dragon.setup xz 0 "v.rotation_factor_translate=-1.8;v.clamped_pitch=180+v.root.x+v.body.x;v.clamped_roll=180-v.root.z;" xrot.body?xzrot.root
CMD:C:AA:U:0
playanimation @a animation.player.attack.rotations y 0 "v.attack_body_rot_y=v.body.y+90*v.is_first_person;" yrot.body
CMD:C:AA:U:0
playanimation @a animation.wolf.shaking z 0 "v.body_rot_z=v.body.z+this+45*v.is_first_person;" zrot.body
CMD:C:AA:U:0
playanimation @a animation.ender_dragon.neck_head_movement xyz 0 "v.head_rotation_x=q.target_x_rotation+v.head.x;v.head_rotation_y=q.target_y_rotation+v.head.y;v.head_rotation_z=11.25*(math.cos(v.body.z)-1)+v.head.z;" xyzrot.head
CMD:C:AA:U:0
playanimation @a animation.player.move.legs x 0 "v.tcos0=(v.rightleg.x-v.leftleg.x)/1.4/2;" xrot.leg_1
CMD:C:AA:U:0
playanimation @a animation.player.move.legs.single x 0 "v.tcos0=(v.leftleg.x+v.rightleg.x)/2-v.body.x;" xrot.leg_2
CMD:C:AA:U:0
playanimation @a animation.zombie.melee_spear_use xyz 0 "v.tp_melee_spear_base_arm_rotation_x=-q.target_x_rotation+q.is_sneaking*27+this;v.tp_melee_spear_use_arm_rotation_x=v.is_holding_left*(-this*0.5-18)-10*(math.sin((1-math.pow(1-v.attack_time,4))*180)*1.2+math.sin(v.attack_time*180)-v.leftarm.x/10)+math.cos(q.modified_distance_moved*38.17)*q.modified_move_speed/v.gliding_speed_value*57.3;v.tp_melee_spear_use_arm_rotation_y=math.clamp(q.target_y_rotation,-60,45)-this-v.leftarm.y;v.tp_melee_spear_use_arm_rotation_z=v.leftarm.z;v.tp_melee_spear_use_item_rotation_x=-22.5;" xyzrot.leftarm
CMD:C:AA:U:0
playanimation @a animation.humanoid.melee_spear_use xyz 0 "v.tp_melee_spear_base_arm_rotation_x=-q.target_x_rotation+q.is_sneaking*27+this;v.tp_melee_spear_use_arm_rotation_x=v.is_holding_right*(-this*0.5-18)-30*(math.sin((1-math.pow(1-v.attack_time,4))*180)*1.2+math.sin(v.attack_time*180)-v.rightarm.x/30)-math.cos(q.modified_distance_moved*38.17)*q.modified_move_speed/v.gliding_speed_value*57.3;v.tp_melee_spear_use_arm_rotation_y=(math.sin((1-math.pow(1-v.attack_time,4))*180)?90*math.sin((1-math.pow(1-v.attack_time,4))*180)-30:0)-math.clamp(q.target_y_rotation,-60,45)+this+v.rightarm.y;v.tp_melee_spear_use_arm_rotation_z=v.rightarm.z-v.leftarm.z;" xyzrot.rightarm
CMD:C:AA:U:0
playanimation @a animation.player.first_person.melee_spear_use n 0 "v.fp_melee_spear_use_item_position_x=1.5;v.fp_melee_spear_use_item_position_y=1;v.fp_melee_spear_use_item_position_z=-0.5;" fix_pos?rot.item

H2: Bonus:

CMD:C:AA:U:0
playanimation @a animation.player.first_person.map_hold_attack y 0 "v.map_angle=0;v.attack_time=0;v.short_arm_offset_right=-(math.sin(v.first_person_item_rotation_factor*(1-v.attack_time)*(1-v.attack_time)*200)*1.75)+v.rightarm.ypos;v.short_arm_offset_left=-(math.sin(v.first_person_item_rotation_factor*(1-v.attack_time)*(1-v.attack_time)*200)*3.75-v.first_person_item_rotation_factor*v.attack_time*1.25)+v.leftarm.ypos;" ypos.rightarm?leftarm
